richiami.difetto: Some tyres may be affected by a manufacturing variation that can lead to a lack of adhesion within the tyre carcass components.
richiami.rimedio: All the 235/65R17 104V Avon ZX7 and 255/60R18 112V Cooper Zeon 4XS Sport Tyres that were produced during week 36 of 2022 (DOT case 3622) and week 37 of 2022 (DOT code 3722) must be exchanged.

richiami.difetto: The affected tyres may have thin inner liner gauge.
richiami.modello: AVON COBRA CHROME 240/50R16 , AVON COBRA CHROME 240/50R16
richiami.titolo: THE AFFECTED TYRES MAY HAVE A THIN INNER LINER GAUGE THAT COULD FAIL

richiami.difetto: The tyres may not comply with the requirements of certain US testing requirements (FMVSS 571.119 S6.1 and S7.2 Endurance).  Specifically S6.1.2.(a) requires at the conclusion of the test there shall be no evidence of broken cords and S7.2 (d) requires the tyre complete the wheel test as indicated in Table III.  The tyres may not complete the prescribed test distance or meet the post-test visual examination requirements.  The affected tyres may develop an in-service unsatisfactory ride condition bulge in the tread area or a tread separation that if undetected may ultimately result in the loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of a possible crash.
richiami.modello: AVON VIPER STRYKE SCOOTER TYRES , AVON VIPER STRYKE SCOOTER TYRES
richiami.rimedio: The manufacturer is recalling affected stock and asking consumers to return affected tyres and providing a refund.
richiami.titolo: TYRE MAY DEFORM AND/OR TEAD DETACH

richiami.difetto: Tyre has not passed ECE regulation 75 following ongoing surveillance testing
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected tyres and replace with approved type
richiami.titolo: TYRE HAS NOT PASSED ECE REG 75 ONGOING SURVEILLANCE TESTING

richiami.difetto: Low adhesion within steel breaker may lead to separation of the breaker and/or the tread from the carcass.
richiami.modello: 185/70 R13C AVON TRAILER 950 , 185/70 R13C AVON TRAILER 950
richiami.rimedio: Recover all suspect tyres and supply quality assured replacements.

richiami.difetto: There have been instances of cracking between the tread and sidewall of some tyres.
richiami.rimedio: Cooper-Avon are contacting all current end users of the vehicles to which theses tyres may have been fitted. Where it is established that any of the subject tyres are still on the vehicle the owner is being directed to an approved local tyre dealer for inspection of the tyres and replacement of any which fall within the affected range.
